_note: example-app additions to gates/policy.default.json. Each exemption is approved by a human and paired with must-pass and must-fail controls in adapters/example-app/selftest/controls.tsv.

extra_rules.description: The example-app server prints a one-time setup token on this log line while the database has no users. The value is generated per start, so it has no fixed shape to match; the line prefix is the anchor.

exemptions.reason: Settings page help text shows the Authorization header with a literal exa_… placeholder after the scheme word, not a token. OCR reads the ellipsis as three dots. Anything after the ellipsis other than one period still fails.
